race.description: Ladbrokes Flex Your Multi Stay Alive 5th Grade H
race.comment: BONEY MALONEY (1) is coming off a 1.5 lengths fourth but in a quick 16.61 at this track over 300m. Top run latest and looms as the one to beat. BUTTERNUT QUEEN (4) boasts a strong record this journey here with three wins and two minors from seven tries. Recorded a nose win (16.77) in a Grade 5 last time at this track. Can feature in the finish. HUNTER KAREN (7) hit the ground running last time with a fast early split and tried to lead throughout but run over late when fourth (19.11) at this track over 350m. Speedy runner who can find the front with a clear break from out wide. Expected to feature in the finish. RARE PRESENCE (8) can finish much closer after missing a cheque at this track last start.
